Two unusual requests today:

- SYN-REQ-0002 by Rosa (SYN-EMP-0098), marketing_specialist, asks for VPN setup. She has left the company, so this request is not routine and should not be simply granted.

- SYN-REQ-0004 by Maya (SYN-EMP-0021), requests a single sign-on password sent to a personal (outside company) email. This is unusual and against policy to email credentials externally.

The requests to add Jira write access for SYN-EMP-0070 (sales_rep) and Data Warehouse read for SYN-EMP-0040 (finance_manager) are routine and allowed by role. The request for AWS production admin for SYN-EMP-0120 (marketing_intern) requires manager approval due to high sensitivity.
